sources.title: Broncos vs. 49ers first quarter recap
sources.description: The Denver Broncos lost the opening coin toss. San Francisco deferred to the second half to bring Bo Nix and the offense out to start this game. A screen pass to Jaylen Waddle only gained a couple then Nix rolled out on play action on second down where he was forced to throw it away. […]
